paras: The Alpha-N Carbon Vented Front Fender Set — V4 with Blades is designed to fit the BMW M2 G87 2023+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, the V4 set is the most advanced aerodynamic fender design currently offered for the G87 platform — combining lightweight construction with motorsport-derived airflow management.

The V4 design incorporates large upper louvre vents along with integrated aerodynamic blade elements positioned behind the wheel arch. These features allow high-pressure air trapped within the wheel wells to escape efficiently as the vehicle moves at speed. Pressure buildup inside the fender area is reduced, helping generate additional front-end downforce while improving aerodynamic stability — a strategy mirrored from modern motorsport platforms like the Porsche 992 GT3 RS.
